name: Before Sleep
description: Long, slow breaths under a quiet sky, to rest with before bed. About six minutes.

cues.text: The day is finished. You can put it down.
Breathe in slowly, and let the breath out even more slowly.
Picture a quiet room, with one small lamp glowing.
If thoughts come, let them float by like clouds in the dark.
Your bed is waiting. You have done enough today.
